description: Source code for generating protocol type definitions for Playwright, including functions to generate protocol types for Chromium, WebKit, and Firefox, and converting JSON protocol descriptions into TypeScript definitions.

methods.name: generateProtocol
methods.description: Main function to generate protocol definitions based on browser name ('chromium', 'firefox', 'webkit').

methods.name: generateChromiumProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript protocol definitions for Chromium by launching a browser instance, retrieving protocol JSON, and converting it.

methods.name: generateWebKitProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript protocol definitions for WebKit by reading a protocol JSON file and converting it.

methods.name: generateFirefoxProtocol
methods.description: Generates TypeScript protocol definitions for Firefox by extracting and evaluating protocol JavaScript from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: jsonToTS
methods.description: Converts JSON protocol description into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: firefoxJSONToTS
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol JSON into TypeScript namespace definitions.

methods.name: typeOfProperty
methods.description: Determines TypeScript type from protocol property definitions.

methods.name: firefoxTypeToString
methods.description: Converts Firefox protocol type objects into TypeScript type strings.
